content.short: Discover Cardano helps users learn the Cardano ecosystem through project information, resources, and tools.
content.description: Discover Cardano is an onboarding and awareness project for the Cardano ecosystem. Its goal is to help more people understand the opportunities available across Cardano by giving them easier access to project information, ecosystem resources, and learning material. In practice, the platform is positioned as a discovery layer for users who want to explore Cardano projects, follow ecosystem developments, and get oriented before they engage more deeply with wallets, tokens, DeFi, or NFTs safely today.
